info.title: MedConnect Saudi API
info.description:
MedConnect Saudi REST API (v1), shared by the web (Vue) and mobile (Flutter) clients.

**Authentication** - send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens are obtained from
`POST /auth/login` or `POST /auth/verify-otp`. Doctors, pharmacy staff and administrators
must complete TOTP multi-factor authentication before receiving a full-access token.

**Errors** - every error uses `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"?, "request_id"}}`.
`code` values are stable; see `docs/api/error-codes.md`.

**Times** are ISO-8601 UTC. **Money** is integer halalas (SAR minor units).

This platform is not an emergency service.

patch.description: Changing the email address marks it unverified and sends a code to the new address.

post.summary: Verify the email address with the emailed code

post.description:
Signs out every device. Clinical and financial records are retained as
required by law; the account can be reactivated by support.

`status` is `authenticated` (full token), `mfa_required` (complete
`POST /auth/mfa/challenge` with `mfa_token`) or `mfa_enrollment_required`
(set up MFA via `POST /auth/mfa/setup` using `mfa_token`).
post.summary: Sign in with phone/email and password

post.description:
Marks the phone number as verified and signs the user in. Privileged roles
(e.g. doctors) receive an MFA enrolment token instead of a full token.

Signs out every device. Unknown accounts and wrong codes return the
same `invalid_otp` error.
post.summary: Reset the password with the emailed / SMS code

post.description:
Always responds 202 - whether or not the number is already registered -
and sends a 6-digit code by SMS. Complete registration with `POST /auth/verify-otp`.
Doctors must additionally complete profile verification before consulting.

post.description:
Returns a TOTP secret and `otpauth://` URL to render as a QR code.
Accepts an enrolment token (`mfa_enrollment_required`) or a full token.

Enables MFA and returns single-use recovery codes (shown only once).
When called with an enrolment token, that token is replaced by a full token.
Requires the `mfa_token` from login. Provide either `code` or a `recovery_code`.
